Author: Serpens66
Name: Serps Mods - Fully Customizable Collection
Description:
All included mods can be freely configured in the in-game Mod Settings.

Included mods:
- Bugfixes and QoL
- Building Costs
- Building Limit
- Extra Features
- Random Events
- CastlePlanner
- Start Conditions
- Unit Costs
- Unit Limit

Changes: Warns in lobby chat when a joining player's Script Extender mod hash differs from the host.
Explicitly opts the diagnostic host settings out of CustomCustomTrail discovery.
Initial unified Steam Workshop mod-pack host.
